user.title: Connect an inverter
user.description: Enter the Modbus TCP address. Tick the simulator to try the integration without hardware (host, port and unit ID are then ignored).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the inverter connection
reconfigure.description: Change the Modbus TCP address, port or unit ID, or switch between the built-in simulator and a real device.

abort.updated_entry: The connection was updated and the integration reloaded
